hints: The ~/work fleet manager: health/clone/adopt/nuke-modules. health exit 1 = repos need attention. Common mistake: adopting into the wrong --kind (products|labs|tools).

actions.name: health
actions.summary: fleet health table (the default action; exit 1 = repos need attention)

actions.name: clone
actions.summary: clone one project repo by slug, or --all missing ones

args.name: slug
args.help: the project slug to clone (omit with --all)

actions.name: adopt
actions.summary: adopt an existing repo path into the ~/work fleet

args.name: --kind
args.help: the ~/work subtree to file it under

actions.name: nuke-modules
actions.summary: delete stale node_modules across the fleet

args.name: --stale
args.help: only dirs untouched for this many days
